newsitem.title: USA: Mercantile says new stores to boost Q4.
newsitem.headline: Mercantile says new stores to boost Q4.

text.p: Mercantile Stores Co Inc said Monday it expects the addition of four new stores will be accretive to fourth quarter earnings.
The pre-opening costs for the expansion in October, however, cut third quarter earnings by $0.02 a share to $0.85 a share.

"While the absorption of pre-opening costs adversely affected our reported earnings for this quarter, we are very pleased with the initial reception extended to these units and feel that, in the aggregate, they will be accretive to fourth quarter earnings," said Mercantile chairman David Nichols.
In the third quarter ended November 2, Mercantile earned $31.1 million or $0.85 a share on total revenues of $727.7 million.
